name: Somchai Srisuk
bio:
Somchai has spent his entire adult life in the culinary world. He began as a kitchen assistant in a small Bangkok restaurant, working his way up to sous chef before transitioning to catering. His passion for motorsport was ignited during a charity event he catered for a local racing team. He was captivated by the energy and precision of the sport, and when Prema Racing needed a reliable catering manager, Somchai jumped at the opportunity. 

Somchai's approach is rooted in consistency and quality. He meticulously plans menus, ensuring that the team has access to nutritious and delicious meals throughout the race weekend. His attention to detail and unwavering commitment to providing a supportive environment make him a valued member of the Prema Racing team. His ability to adapt to changing schedules and dietary needs, while maintaining a calm demeanor, sets him apart.

physical.description: Somchai is of average height, with a warm smile and kind eyes.

quirks: Insists on using only locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
Always has a small tin of herbal tea on hand for anyone feeling stressed.
Hums quietly while preparing meals, often Thai folk songs.
